nodes.label: compose.external-db.yml overlay
nodes.rationale: Use an existing Postgres; !reset removes bundled postgres and its depends_on; volume kept declared so down -v does not strand data.

nodes.label: compose.split worker service
nodes.rationale: Gated on app healthy because worker mode does not apply migrations.

nodes.label: App Deployment template
nodes.rationale: Recreate strategy in combined mode because the pod also runs the ingestion loop; RollingUpdate in split mode.

nodes.label: Worker Deployment template
nodes.rationale: Rendered only in split mode; Recreate strategy and no probes since worker has no HTTP listener.

nodes.label: GHCR canonical + Docker Hub mirror
nodes.rationale: Docker Hub push skipped unless DOCKERHUB_TOKEN set.

nodes.label: APP_MODE runtime modes (api, worker, all, migrate)
nodes.norm_label: app_mode runtime modes (api, worker, all, migrate)
nodes.rationale: Any other value fails startup so a typo cannot serve the console while ingesting nothing.

nodes.label: Two axes: mode (combined/split) and postgres.enabled
nodes.rationale: Same axes as the Compose overlays so deployments move between Compose and Kubernetes.

nodes.label: Image release channels (latest, edge, sha, semver)
nodes.norm_label: image release channels (latest, edge, sha, semver)
nodes.rationale: latest tracks releases not main so README quick-start is reproducible.

nodes.label: Exactly one ingestion worker per database
nodes.norm_label: exactly one ingestion worker per database
nodes.rationale: No claim mechanism in the queue; a second worker duplicates alert/digest email, breaks retention purge and can move the mailbox checkpoint backwards.

nodes.label: Healthcheck on /api/v1/auth/setup with 150s start_period
nodes.rationale: Migrations like AddDmarcReportRecordRangeBegin rewrite 5.3M rows in ~94s.

nodes.label: Pinned PGDATA for postgres 18
nodes.rationale: postgres 18 moved default PGDATA; pinning makes a major-version change fail loudly instead of silently serving an empty database.

nodes.label: App demoted from all to api in split overlay
nodes.norm_label: app demoted from all to api in split overlay
nodes.rationale: Mode change and new container in one file so two schedulers cannot be reached by combination.

nodes.label: App readiness/liveness/startup probes
nodes.rationale: Startup probe stops liveness killing the pod mid-migration.

nodes.label: CI workflow (ci.yml)
nodes.rationale: Test everything on every push/PR; build image; publish only on tags/main, never from pull requests.

nodes.label: Push Artifact Hub metadata via oras
nodes.norm_label: push artifact hub metadata via oras

nodes.label: CI changes job (docs-only image skip)
nodes.rationale: Doc-only pushes to main skip the image; tags and PRs always build.

nodes.label: CI chart job (lint, render, guardrails, publish)
nodes.norm_label: ci chart job (lint, render, guardrails, publish)
nodes.rationale: Rendering every supported combination is the only proof templating works.

nodes.label: CI image job (multi-arch build + push)
nodes.rationale: 45-minute timeout because emulated arm64 hangs ran to the 6-hour default twice.

nodes.label: CI test job
nodes.rationale: Runs InMemory API tests, Testcontainers integration tests, frontend type-check/test/build.

nodes.label: Prepare release workflow

nodes.label: values.schema.json validation
nodes.rationale: Pattern-checks encryption key (base64 32 bytes) and full sha256 digest.

nodes.label: Chart.yaml matches the tag check
nodes.rationale: VersionReferenceTests only catches drift between files, not a stale Chart.yaml; only a tag knows the intended version.

nodes.label: SOURCE_REVISION commit stamping
nodes.rationale: Release builds unstamped (tag pins commit); edge builds report version+sha. Shell step avoids falsy empty-string expression bug.

nodes.label: migrations.strategy (job vs startup)

nodes.label: Secret and ServiceAccount as pre-install hooks

nodes.label: Init container waits for database
nodes.rationale: Kubernetes lacks depends_on service_healthy; avoids crash-loop-looking restarts.

nodes.label: Signed magic links (single-client, read-only, 7-day, DB nonce)
nodes.norm_label: signed magic links (single-client, read-only, 7-day, db nonce)
nodes.rationale: Reduce account overhead for occasional client access; nonce-backed revocation. Still unbuilt.

nodes.norm_label: agency cookie session policy (12h idle, 7d absolute)

nodes.norm_label: hybrid oidc flow via external-temp cookie and /complete endpoint

nodes.label: RoleAuthorizationMiddleware deny-by-default enforcement
nodes.rationale: New endpoints are invisible to viewers unless explicitly opted in via AllowClientViewer.

nodes.label: AllowMachineCredential(kind) deny-by-default allowlist
nodes.rationale: Machines get no role and no synthetic user; endpoints must opt in per Kind.

nodes.label: Lightweight DB-backed job queue
nodes.rationale: Reliable retries/resumability with minimal external components; costs careful locking semantics and index tuning.

nodes.label: Global 60-minute polling, 24/7, with oldest-to-newest checkpointed backfill
nodes.norm_label: global 60-minute polling, 24/7, with oldest-to-newest checkpointed backfill

nodes.label: Kubernetes CronJob-triggered worker runs
nodes.rationale: Aligns with the periodic 60-minute schedule and resource control, at the cost of slight delay versus an always-on worker.

nodes.label: EF migrations via dedicated init job
nodes.norm_label: ef migrations via dedicated init job
nodes.rationale: Avoids races from multi-replica startup migration.

nodes.label: Single container image with runtime mode switch
nodes.norm_label: single container image with runtime mode switch
nodes.rationale: One build artifact simplifies release; mode switching adds configuration complexity.

nodes.label: APP_MODE=all combined runtime mode
nodes.rationale: Web host already registers every worker service; worker differs by one AddHostedService line. Unrecognised APP_MODE fails startup since a silent api fallback ingests nothing.

nodes.label: Compose overlays (compose.yml, compose.external-db.yml, compose.split.yml) using !reset
nodes.rationale: Base file stays a complete quick start because its raw URL is published; profiles rejected because they allow APP_MODE=all plus a worker (two schedulers).

nodes.label: Helm chart (postgres.enabled, mode combined|split, pre-upgrade migration Job)
nodes.norm_label: helm chart (postgres.enabled, mode combined|split, pre-upgrade migration job)
nodes.rationale: Minimal in-chart Postgres StatefulSet instead of Bitnami due to 2025 distribution term changes.

nodes.label: WorkerSingleInstanceLock Postgres advisory lock (exactly one worker)
nodes.norm_label: workersingleinstancelock postgres advisory lock (exactly one worker)
nodes.rationale: No claim path exists; a second worker duplicates alert/digest mail, breaks retention purge, and can move checkpoints backwards. A DB lock covers Compose and K8s alike.

nodes.label: QueueWorkerService worker pass loop
nodes.rationale: Catches its own exceptions with backoff so a bad pass cannot stop the host.

nodes.label: APP_MODE runtime modes (api, worker, all, migrate)
nodes.norm_label: app_mode runtime modes (api, worker, all, migrate)
nodes.rationale: migrate exists because startup migration races across replicas and the admin endpoint needs the very instance being waited for.

nodes.label: Render one-click Blueprint (APP_MODE=all + managed Postgres)
nodes.rationale: Image tag pinned (not latest) because Render sync only reacts to file changes; enforced by VersionReferenceTests.

nodes.label: Four migration paths (startup, APP_MODE=migrate, dotnet-ef, admin endpoint)
nodes.norm_label: four migration paths (startup, app_mode=migrate, dotnet-ef, admin endpoint)

nodes.label: AnalyticsQueryService on-demand aggregation
nodes.rationale: No pre-aggregated table; navigations flattened before GroupBy because EF correlated subqueries took 33s vs ~75ms.

nodes.label: Network forwarded headers with mandatory trust list
nodes.norm_label: network forwarded headers with mandatory trust list
nodes.rationale: Empty trust list would let any caller spoof its audit address.

nodes.label: 10-minute migration command timeout on all migration paths
nodes.norm_label: 10-minute migration command timeout on all migration paths
nodes.rationale: AddDmarcReportRecordRangeBegin rewrites ~5M rows; Npgsql 30s default is insufficient.

nodes.label: Tenant isolation enforced in application code (no HasQueryFilter)
nodes.norm_label: tenant isolation enforced in application code (no hasqueryfilter)
nodes.rationale: Single most important invariant; nothing in the data layer catches a query that forgets it.

nodes.label: Source default-client fallback / domain auto-create
nodes.rationale: Auto-created domains can capture unexpected domains without governance.

nodes.label: dmarc_report table (dedup key DomainId, ReportId, range)
nodes.norm_label: dmarc_report table (dedup key domainid, reportid, range)
nodes.rationale: Dedup is domain-scoped; reporting org excluded so a report arriving via two mailboxes is not double counted.

nodes.label: dmarc_report_record table (denormalised ReportRangeBeginUtc)
nodes.rationale: Immutable range copied onto records turns window filter into bitmap index scan instead of scanning 5.27M rows.

nodes.label: domain table (globally unique Name, effective DnsPolicy)
nodes.norm_label: domain table (globally unique name, effective dnspolicy)
nodes.rationale: Effective policy stored rather than derived because ancestors are usually not monitored domains; a failed lookup keeps the previous policy.

nodes.label: report_source table (protocol, per-protocol checkpoints)
nodes.rationale: Three separate checkpoint columns (UID, UIDL, S3 timestamp+key) because they are different kinds of value.

nodes.label: Helm migration Job (pre-install/pre-upgrade hook)
nodes.rationale: Suffixed with release revision so each upgrade gets its own immutable Job; kept on failure for log diagnosis; APP_MODE=migrate completes before any app pod starts.

nodes.label: dmarc.validate guardrail include
nodes.rationale: Rendered from its own file so refused configurations report validation.yaml rather than whichever template evaluated first.

nodes.label: app.replicas (pinned to 1 in combined mode)
nodes.rationale: Each combined replica runs its own ingestion loop, so two replicas means two schedulers claiming the same mailboxes.

nodes.label: worker.replicas (pinned to 1)
nodes.rationale: No claim mechanism in the queue; duplicate loops duplicate sync passes, alerts, digests and can move checkpoints backwards.

nodes.label: Single worker advisory lock (Worker__EnforceSingleInstance)
nodes.rationale: Postgres advisory lock is the only guard that works on every platform; Helm replicas guard only covers Kubernetes.

nodes.label: One-shot migration via run --rm APP_MODE=migrate
nodes.rationale: Does not serve, ingest or take the worker lock, so the running instance keeps serving; idempotent.

nodes.label: CI renders six value combinations and asserts guardrails
nodes.norm_label: ci renders six value combinations and asserts guardrails
nodes.rationale: Single render leaves migration Job and worker Deployment unexercised.

nodes.label: Green healthcheck does not prove schema is current
nodes.norm_label: green healthcheck does not prove schema is current
nodes.rationale: compose up -d recreates only on config/image change; a pending migration is invisible to Compose.

nodes.norm_label: ingestion and routing flow (fetch, extract, parse, resolve domain, dedup, persist)

nodes.norm_label: polled ingestion over imap, pop3, s3 (ipolledsourcetransport)

nodes.norm_label: configuration contract with ci drift check (docs/ops/configuration.md)

nodes.label: Credential decides the client, never the request body
nodes.norm_label: credential decides the client, never the request body
nodes.rationale: A leaked credential is bounded to one source, one client, one endpoint; preserves ADR 0001 tenancy.

nodes.norm_label: split token dmarcanalyzer_<tokenid>_<secret> hashed with sha-256
nodes.rationale: 256-bit random secret has no guessing attack, so PBKDF2 would add ~100ms per request against an imaginary threat.

nodes.rationale: Report data excluded because it can be re-ingested; artifact is a credential file so the encryption key must never share the bucket; refuses to run with no key.

nodes.label: Database__MigrateOnStartup
nodes.rationale: On Kubernetes leave false and use the migration Job; startup migration races with more than one replica. Worker mode never migrates.

nodes.label: OpenTelemetry (OTEL_*)
nodes.rationale: Spec variable names reused; Npgsql driver-level spans because EF duration stops at first row; unknown exporter falls back rather than failing boot.

nodes.label: Report decompression caps (MaxReportEntryBytes etc.)
nodes.rationale: rua= address is public in DNS, so caps stop decompression bombs from strangers; mailbox path ignores excess entries, push path refuses with 413.

nodes.label: Security__CredentialEncryptionKey
nodes.rationale: AES-256-GCM for mailbox passwords; losing or changing it makes stored credentials undecryptable.

nodes.label: Caddy on-demand TLS with /mta-sts/ask
nodes.rationale: ask endpoint prevents strangers pointing DNS at the instance from minting certificates.

nodes.label: Dedicated mta-sts container
nodes.rationale: Isolates internet-facing traffic; holds no credential encryption key; never migrates.

nodes.label: Hosted MTA-STS policy serving
nodes.rationale: Per-domain HTTPS endpoint with certificate is why fleets skip MTA-STS; app serves policies, onboarding becomes CNAME+TXT.

nodes.label: Bundled Postgres StatefulSet
nodes.rationale: PGDATA pinned to a subdirectory so the image starts on a volume containing lost+found; evaluation-grade single replica.

nodes.label: Compose api service (APP_MODE=api)
nodes.rationale: Healthcheck on /api/v1/auth/setup with 150s start_period because Kestrel does not listen until migrations (some multi-minute) finish.

nodes.rationale: start-dev uses embedded H2 store, so no database preparation needed.
